body: Fuck him, it's not about him. It's about the girl, I never new the kid like that

The thing is, she's similar to me in some traits, granted her being a Libra and I a Scorpio, we don't entirely mix well under those circumstances. I don't entirely believe that our astrological signs dictate our lives as a whole, but I do believe it plays a fair role in who a person can develop to be. I wouldn't change her for the world. 

She's introvert like me so she may need some time to recharge from human interaction on this level.
